mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT signals a gradual return of commuting and weekday foot traffic, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 28-day mean over the next 28 days despite continued week-over-week gains in WORKPLACES or TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while WORKPLACES remains depressed, households substitute toward local shopping and errands, pushing RETAIL_REC higher within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 9 points while WORKPLACES stays below -15 points for at least 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL stays high and WORKPLACES stays deeply negative for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A fresh drop in TRANSIT below its recent level signals fewer city-center trips and weaker spontaneous shopping visits, which should pull RETAIL_REC down over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 2 points week-on-week after being above -31 for at least one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the next 28 days after TRANSIT posts a week-on-week decline greater than 2 points.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM weakens while RETAIL_REC is already subdued, it indicates broad caution and fewer in-person errands overall, which should keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM drops below -5 points for 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining below -5 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A strengthening PARKS series relative to its prior weeks absorbs discretionary outings into outdoor activities, reducing demand for retail-and-recreation trips and lowering RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS is at or above its recent 4-week average.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL rises together with PARKS, more time is spent near home and in outdoor leisure instead of retail venues, producing a lower RETAIL_REC trend within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL increases while PARKS also increases for 2 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after simultaneous two-week increases in RESIDENTIAL and PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, any renewed decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT should quickly suppress retail visits, because commuting-linked shopping and discretionary trips contract together.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both fall week-on-week after already being negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT post week-on-week drops from negative levels.

mechanism_narrative: A modest improvement in GROCERY_PHARM alongside rising RETAIL_REC indicates broader normalization of out-of-home errands, so RETAIL_REC should remain above its last-month average over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM improves by at least 1 point from its prior week while remaining negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls below its prior 28-day mean over the next 28 days despite a week-over-week improvement in GROCERY_PHARM.
